description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Goteo\Model\Glossary class, testing its various functionalities including creation, validation, editing, language setting, listing, and deletion of glossary entries, as well as related image handling.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\GlossaryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class to test the Goteo\Model\Glossary functionalities.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up temporary files and initial configuration before all tests run.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Glossary class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests validation and saving of an empty Glossary instance.

methods.name: testCreateGlossary
methods.description: Creates a new Glossary entry and tests validation and persistence.

methods.name: testGetGlossary
methods.description: Retrieves a Glossary by ID and verifies its contents.

methods.name: testEditGlossary
methods.description: Edits a Glossary's attributes, adds images, and verifies changes.

methods.name: testRemoveImageGlossary
methods.description: Removes images from the Glossary's gallery and verifies cleanup.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Tests setting a language-specific translation for the Glossary.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Verifies that language-specific data is correctly retrieved for different languages.

methods.name: testListing
methods.description: Checks that glossaries are correctly listed, considering language context.

methods.name: testDeleteGlossary
methods.description: Deletes a Glossary and confirms removal.

methods.name: testCleanProjectRelated
methods.description: Cleans up database inconsistencies in related tables.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during setup after all tests.
